15343-a-little-book-for-christmas.creator: Unknown
15343-a-little-book-for-christmas.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. id the younger of  the twain. “I am sure, Miss, that they do wish you a Merry Christmas.”  “The Stars look down”  “Thrusting his toes into the straps he struck out boldly.”  “The world bows down to a Mother and her Child—and the Mother herself  is at the feet of the Child.”

35589-the-story-of-my-life-volumes-1-3.title: My Life
35589-the-story-of-my-life-volumes-1-3.creator: Unknown
35589-the-story-of-my-life-volumes-1-3.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In 1727, the year of George the First's death, Miss Grace Naylor of Hurstmonceaux, though she was beloved, charming, and beautiful, died very mysteriously in her twenty-first year, in the immense and weird old castle of which she had been the heiress. She was affirmed to have been starved by her former governess, who lived alone with her, but the fact was never proved.

arxiv-1809-02172.title: On the tree-width of knot diagrams Thanks: This work is in the public domain.
arxiv-1809-02172.creator: Arnaud de Mesmay, Jessica Purcell, Saul Schleimer, Eric Sedgwick
arxiv-1809-02172.description: Abstract . We show that a small tree-decomposition of a knot diagram induces a small sphere-decomposition of the corresponding knot. This, in turn, implies that the knot admits a small essential planar meridional surface or a small bridge sphere. We use this to give the first examples of knots where any diagram has high tree-width.

arxiv-2004-02253.title: Kollaps : Decentralized and Dynamic Topology Emulation Conference: Fifteenth European Conference on Computer Systems; April 27–30, 2020; Heraklion, Greece ISBN: 978-1-4503-6882-7/20/04 CCS: Networks Network experimentation
arxiv-2004-02253.creator: Paulo Gouveia, João Neves, Carlos Segarra, Luca Liechti, Shady Issa, Valerio Schiavoni, Miguel Matos
arxiv-2004-02253.description: Abstract . The performance and behavior of large-scale distributed applications is highly influenced by network properties such as latency, bandwidth, packet loss, and jitter. For instance, an engineer might need to answer questions such as: What is the impact of an increase in network latency in application response time? How does moving a cluster between geographical regions affect application throughput?

arxiv-2107-05009.title: PocketVAE: A two-step model for groove generation and control
arxiv-2107-05009.description: Abstract Creating a good drum track to imitate a skilled performer in digital audio workstations (DAWs) can be a time-consuming process, especially for those unfamiliar with drums. In this work, we introduce PocketVAE, a groove generation system that applies grooves to users’ rudimentary MIDI tracks, i.e, templates.

arxiv-2203-07466.title: Local uniqueness of semiclassical bounded states for a singularly perturbed fractional Kirchhoff problem Thanks: Corresponding author. Email: yangzhipeng326@163.com
arxiv-2203-07466.creator: Vicenţiu D. Rădulescu
arxiv-2203-07466.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Vicenţiu D. Rădulescu. In this paper, we consider the following singularly perturbed fractional Kirchhoff problem \Big(\varepsilon^{2s}a+\varepsilon^{4s-N}b{\int_{\mathbb{R}^{N}}}|(-\Delta)^{\frac{s}{2}}u|^{2}dx\Big)(-\Delta)^{s}u+V(x)u=|u|^{p-2}u,\quad\text{in}\ \mathbb{R}^{N}, where a,b>0 , 2s<N<4s with s\in(0,1) , 2<p<2^{*}_{s}=\frac{2N}{N-2s} and (-\Delta)^{s} is the fractional Laplacian. For \varepsilon>0 sufficiently small and a bounded continuous function V , we establish a type of local Pohozǎev identity by extension technique and then we can obtain the local uniqueness of semiclassical bounded solutions based on our recent results on the uniqueness and non-degeneracy of positive solutions to the limit problem.

arxiv-2205-14622.title: Unified Approach to Secret Sharing and Symmetric Private Information Retrieval with Colluding Servers in Quantum Systems
arxiv-2205-14622.creator: Masahito Hayashi, and Seunghoan Song
arxiv-2205-14622.description: Abstract This paper unifiedly addresses two kinds of key quantum secure tasks, i.e., quantum versions of secret sharing (SS) and symmetric private information retrieval (SPIR) by using multi-target monotone span program (MMSP), which characterizes the classical linear protocols of SS and SPIR.

arxiv-2208-00864.title: 100 Years of the (Critical) Ising Model on the Hypercubic Lattice Volume: 1
arxiv-2208-00864.description: Abstract We take the occasion of this article to review one hundred years of the physical and mathematical study of the Ising model. The model, introduced by Lenz in 1920, has been at the cornerstone of many major revolutions in statistical mechanics. We wish, through its history, to outline some of these amazing developments.

arxiv-2210-07835.title: Mutual-visibility in strong products of graphs via total mutual-visibility
arxiv-2210-07835.creator: Serafino Cicerone, Gabriele Di Stefano, Sandi Klavžar, Ismael G. Yero
arxiv-2210-07835.description: Abstract Let G G be a graph and X ⊆ V ⁡ ( G ) X\subseteq V(G) . Then X X is a mutual-visibility set if each pair of vertices from X X is connected by a geodesic with no internal vertex in X X .

arxiv-2309-13198.title: Associative memory by virtual oscillator network based on single spin-torque oscillator
arxiv-2309-13198.creator: Yusuke Imai, Tomohiro Taniguchi
arxiv-2309-13198.description: Abstract A coupled oscillator network may be able to perform an energy-efficient associative memory operation. However, its realization has been difficult because inhomogeneities unavoidably arise among the oscillators during fabrication and lead to an unreliable operation. This issue could be resolved if the oscillator network were able to be formed from a single oscillator.

arxiv-2408-00585.title: Constraints on large-scale polarization in northern hemisphere
arxiv-2408-00585.creator: Dongdong Zhang, Bo Wang, Jia-Rui Li, Yi-Fu Cai, Chang Feng
arxiv-2408-00585.description: Abstract Present cosmic microwave background (CMB) observations have significantly advanced our understanding of the universe’s origin, especially with primordial gravitational waves (PGWs). Currently, ground-based CMB telescopes are mainly located in the southern hemisphere, leaving an untapped potential for observations in the northern hemisphere.

arxiv-2409-15555.title: Independent set sequence of some linear hypertrees
arxiv-2409-15555.creator: David Galvin, Courtney Sharpe
arxiv-2409-15555.description: Abstract The independent set sequence of trees has been well studied, with much effort devoted to the (still open) question of Alavi, Malde, Schwenk and Erdős on whether the independent set sequence of a tree is always unimodal. Much less attention has been given to the independent set sequence of hypertrees.

arxiv-2503-17006.title: Prompt stellar and binary black hole mergers in tight triples
arxiv-2503-17006.creator: A. Vigna-Gómez, E. Grishin, J. Stegmann, A. Olejak, S. A. Popa, B. Liu, A. S. Rajamuthukumar, L. A. C. van Son, A. Bobrick, A. Dorozsmai
arxiv-2503-17006.description: Abstract Short-period massive binary stars are predicted to undergo a chemically homogeneous evolution (CHE), making them prime candidates for producing binary black holes (BBHs) that have the potential to merge within the age of the Universe. Most of these binaries have a tertiary companion and here we explore how a nearby third body could possibly influence this evolutionary channel.

arxiv-2510-19800.title: Chromospherically active stars: Lithium and CNO abundances in northern RS CVn stars
arxiv-2510-19800.creator: B. Bale, G. Tautvaišienė, R. Minkevičiūtė, A. Drazdauskas, Š. Mikolaitis, E. Stonkutė, M. Ambrosch
arxiv-2510-19800.description: Abstract Aims. We carried out a detailed investigation of Lthium and CNO abundances, including carbon isotope ratios, in RS CVn stars to assess the role of magnetic activity in the mixing of stellar atmospheres. Methods. We obtained high-resolution spectra at the Moletai Astronomical Observatory.

pmc-11431368.creator: Zorica Tomičić, Ljubiša Šarić, Ružica Tomičić, Tatiana Colombo Pimentel, Xiaoyang Pang
pmc-11431368.description: Probiotic organisms are increasingly being incorporated into foods in order to develop products to prevent and reduce many diseases. Saccharomyces boulardii, a probiotic yeast with unique properties, such as viability over a wide pH range, antibiotic resistance, and the ability to reach a steady state, has an advantage over bacterial probiotics. The present review highlights the potential application of S.

pmc-11585250.title: Sex-related differences in profiles and clinical outcomes of Inflammatory bowel disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11585250.creator: Dana A Salem, Rawan El-Ijla, Razan R AbuMusameh, Khaled A Zakout, Alaa Y Abu Halima, Mohammed T Abudiab, Yahya M Banat, Basel F Alqeeq, Mohammed Al-Tawil, Khaled Matar
pmc-11585250.description: BackgroundInflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic and idiopathic condition that includes both Crohn’s disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC). The impact of sex on the disease course and the clinical outcomes not fully understood. Our systematic review and meta-analysis aims to explore the differences in the clinical outcomes in IBD.

pmc-11650859.title: A 5-Month-Old Infant With a Complicated Holiday Souvenir
pmc-11650859.creator: Iris Voogd, Sanne A (S ) E Kooistra, Jamie A van der Meer, Soëba Ehsary, Clementien Vermont, Els van Nood, Marjolijn S W Quaak, Anthony Amoroso, Priya Nori, David J Riedel
pmc-11650859.description: remarkable. He had been adequately vaccinated for his age. The travel history included a visit to Morocco at the age of 2 months. Prior to presentation in our hospital, empirical sepsis treatment was initiated. However, blood cultures were negative and the child remained febrile after 48 hours of antibiotic treatment.

pmc-12472753.title: Fused Imidazotriazole-Based Therapeutics: A Multidisciplinary Study Against Diabetes-Linked Enzymes Alpha-Amylase and Alpha-Glucosidase Using In Vitro and In Silico Methods
pmc-12472753.creator: Manal M. Khowdiary, Shifa Felemban
pmc-12472753.description: Background/Objective: The present study reports the design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of novel imidazo-triazole derivatives as potential antidiabetic agents. Methods: The novel series was synthesized by treating amino-triazole bearing carboxylic acid with substituted 2-bromo acetophenone and was biologically compared with acarbose under in vitro analysis.

pmc-12541037.title: Strength, deformation and macro and micro-failure performances of the bolted samples under biaxial compression
pmc-12541037.creator: Hua Nan, Jing Qiao, Shuxue Ding, Yibo Chen, Peilin Jiang, Sijiang Wei
pmc-12541037.description: The surrounding rock between two ultra-closely spaced roadways, under biaxial compression (BC) condition, exhibits high failure propensity and consequently poses serious threats to the coal mining operations. The counter-pulled rockbolt (hereinafter referred as “bolt”) is widely employed to improve the stability of this kind of surrounding rock.

pmc-12753083.title: Circular RNA profiling revealed an evolutionarily conserved circACACA promotes liver lipid metabolism, oxidative stress, and autophagy disorder in a ceRNA manner
pmc-12753083.creator: Jing Zhao, Shunshun Han, Jialin Xiang, Yuqi Chen, Xiyu Zhao, Wenjuan Wang, Yao Zhang, Qing Zhu, Chang Liu, Huadong Yin
pmc-12753083.description: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is a clinical syndrome characterized primarily by hepatocellular steatosis and lipid accumulation, which leads to hepatocyte apoptosis, autophagy, inflammation, and intracellular oxidative stress. NAFLD is recognized as one of the most prevalent and complex chronic liver diseases globally, with its occurrence and associated mortality rates rising swiftly each year.

pmc-13086939.title: Experiences and opinion of medical professionals regarding the use of telemedicine tools in management of patients with chronic diseases: a cross-sectional survey
pmc-13086939.creator: Beata Jankowska-Polańska, Wojciech Stefan Zgliczyński, Małgorzata Wywrot, Wojciech Tański
pmc-13086939.description: Telemedicine has rapidly become a vital tool in managing chronic diseases, yet its effective integration relies on the acceptance and preparedness of healthcare professionals. This study aimed to assess the experiences, opinions, and expectations of medical professionals regarding telemedicine tools in patient care.

pmc-13324246.title: Comprehensive Chemical and Biological Evaluation of Rosa damascena Plant Parts and Industrial Residues Using FTIR‐ATR and LC–MS/MS
pmc-13324246.creator: Burak Bayrak, Hafize Yuca, Yasemin Beyza Budak, Satuk Buğra Alkuyruk, Elif Beyza Özer, Gülnur Ekşi Bona, Bilge Aydın, Mehmet Karadayı, Yusuf Gülşahin, Alptuğ Atila, Gamze Göger, Songul Karakaya
pmc-13324246.description: This study comprehensively evaluated the phytochemical composition, biological activities, and biosafety profile of different organs and processing by‐products of Rosa damascena, with particular emphasis on valorizing pruning residues and distillation wastes. Extraction yields varied among plant parts, with leaves (29.69%) and flowers (14.15%) providing higher recoveries than buds (7.98%) and branches (7.91%).

pmc-13415225.title: Anaemia Prevention Among Adolescent Girls in Lodhran, Punjab, Pakistan: A School-Based Weekly Iron-Folic Acid Supplementation Pilot Program
pmc-13415225.creator: Sumra Kureishy, Asim Shahzad Qureshi, Rakhshinda Ambreen, Shabina Raza, Marion L. Roche
pmc-13415225.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: Pakistan has one of the highest burdens of adolescent anaemia in South Asia. A Weekly Iron-Folic Acid Supplementation (WIFAS) program for school-going adolescent girls aged 10–19 years was piloted in the Lodhran District, Punjab, Pakistan. Methods: A quantitative cross-sectional study was conducted among 750 girls, selected by multi-stage random cluster sampling from 50 public schools across Lodhran; qualitative data were generated through in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with 327 stakeholders. Quantitative data were analyzed using a chi-square test in SPSS.
